name: ultraterm-computer-use
description: Open-source cross-platform Computer Use MCP server packaged as a Codex plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Local desktop control for MCP-capable agents
interface.longDescription: UltraTerm Computer Use exposes nine desktop-control tools through a local macOS app or native Linux and Windows runtimes. It prefers accessibility actions before fallback input and keeps prompts and screenshots on the machine.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current UI state without stealing focus when possible
Use semantic controls before moving my real pointer
Drive the fixture app and verify the nine computer-use tools
